metadata.title: Clicked like a lost toddler and somehow got 2 kills? Valorant is broken again
metadata.description:
Spammed like I was panicking for snacks.
Enemy probably thinking I’m cheating or just lucky.
Did NOT deserve those but hey, chaos loves me today.
If your aim’s a beautiful mess, you’ll get this.

Tap if your aim’s a glorious disaster too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
